setup.zh: 扬鼎从洞底的水里升起来。鼎身上铸着三江、震泽和一片橘林——扬州的一切。鼎腹上映着一张脸，不是你的：一个老妇人的脸，手背上有鼎的花纹。
setup.en: The Cauldron of Yang rises from the water at the cave's bottom. Cast on its body are the three rivers, Zhenze and an orange grove — everything of Yang. On its belly a face is reflected, not yours: an old woman's face, with the pattern of a cauldron on the back of her hand.

recap.zh: 扬鼎升起，鼎腹上映出一张老妇人的脸，她的手背上有鼎纹。
recap.en: The Cauldron of Yang rose, and on its belly was reflected an old woman's face, a cauldron's pattern on the back of her hand.

text.zh: 是她。……她不是我娘。我没有人，她也没有人，就凑成了两个。
text.en: It's her. …She wasn't my mother. I had no one, and she had no one, so we made two.

alone.zh: 鼎腹上的老妇人看着你，像在认一个人。
alone.en: The old woman on the cauldron's belly looks at you as if trying to know someone.

label.en: Take the cauldron's breath · Void Refinement

exits.means: touches the cauldron, takes its breath, attempts the breakthrough

refuse.zh: 鼎气涌上来又退开。化神未满，炼不了虚。先回人间，把功课做满。
refuse.en: The breath surges over you and draws back. Your Deity Transformation is not yet full; you cannot refine the Void. Go back to the world and fill your practice first.

text.zh: 三条江从三面流进丹田，流过元神，又流出去，什么也没留下——只留下空。空里什么都装得下。鼎小了，小到握在掌心，和前四口并排。
text.en: Three rivers flow into your dantian from three sides, through the spirit and out again, leaving nothing — nothing but emptiness, and emptiness holds everything. The cauldron shrinks until it sits in your palm beside the other four.

exits.means: hesitates, asks what will happen, wants to prepare first

text.zh: 防风氏等了两千年。它不差这一会儿。
text.en: Fangfeng waited two thousand years. It can spare a little while.

alone.zh: 防风氏等了两千年。这鼎也等得起。
alone.en: Fangfeng waited two thousand years. This cauldron can wait too.
